meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在 NanoClaw 群里搭建一个持久 wiki 知识库:创建 wiki/ 和 sources/ 文件夹,生成索引、日志和一套维护规则,并让智能体按“一次处理一个源文件”的方式整理资料。
howto.when: 当你说出“add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base”等关键词,或要求添加知识库时触发。

say.text: 给我的 NanoClaw 群加上 Karpathy wiki 知识库。
say.note: 会询问选择哪个群,然后开始搭建。

say.text: 为群添加 wiki,支持 PDF、网页等来源。
say.note: 会与你讨论设计,并检查需要的技能。

say.text: 创建 LLM wiki,并安排每周一次的检查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude sets up a persistent wiki knowledge base in a NanoClaw group: it creates wiki/ and sources/ folders, generates index and log files, adds a maintenance skill, and updates CLAUDE.md so the agent processes sources one at a time.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says keywords like "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", etc., or asks to add a knowledge base.

say_en.text: Add a Karpathy LLM wiki to my NanoClaw group.
say_en.note: It asks which group, then starts building.

say_en.text: Add a wiki to the group, supporting PDFs and web pages.
say_en.note: It discusses design and checks needed skills.

say_en.text: Create an LLM wiki and schedule a weekly check.
